title: 10. Exercises: Python Dictionaries - Complete Mastery Guide

objectives: Solve the Python Dictionaries - Complete Mastery Guide exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Practice Exercises
sections.body:
### Beginner Level

1. Create a dictionary to store information about 5 books (title, author, year, price)
2. Write a function to find the most expensive book
3. Create a phone book dictionary and implement search functionality
4. Count the frequency of characters in a string using a dictionary

### Intermediate Level

1. Implement a simple inventory management system using nested dictionaries
2. Create a grade calculator that stores student data and calculates GPAs
3. Write a function to merge multiple dictionaries with conflict resolution
4. Implement a simple caching decorator using dictionaries

### Advanced Level

1. Create a text analyzer that uses dictionaries to store word frequencies, positions, and statistics
2. Implement a configuration system that supports environment variables and file-based configs
3. Build a simple ORM-like system using dictionaries to represent database records
4. Create a multi-level caching system with TTL and LRU eviction

Remember: Practice these concepts regularly, and try to use dictionaries in your real projects to master them completely!
